mode.title: Mode
mode.description: alerts = one row per outage event with the networks affected. summary = one row per country or network with an outage score for the whole window.

hoursBack.title: Hours to look back
hoursBack.description: How far back to search. A quiet day may return very little, which is the correct answer rather than a failure.

entityType.title: Level of detail
entityType.description: country and region are national and subnational outages. asn is a single network operator. geoasn is one operator within one country.

country.title: Country codes (optional)
country.description: Two letter codes such as NG, IR, SD. Empty watches the whole world.

onlyOutages.title: Only outages
onlyOutages.description: On by default. The raw feed mixes recoveries in with outages, and recoveries are the majority. Turn this off to see connectivity returning too.

minDropPercent.title: Minimum traffic drop percent
minDropPercent.description: Keep only events where traffic fell at least this far below the network's own normal level. 0 keeps everything.

minSources.title: Minimum corroborating sources
minSources.description: How many independent measurement systems must have seen the event. Raising this to 2 is the simplest way to filter out measurement noise.

groupEvents.title: Group reports of the same event
groupEvents.description: On by default. Each measurement system reports separately, so without grouping one outage appears as several rows.

maxResults.title: Max rows per run
maxResults.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost.
